title: Nourishing Irish Turkey Neck Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew featuring turkey neck, perfect for a hangover cure or a cozy meal. The brine-dried turkey neck adds a pillowy texture and a salty flavor.

ingredients.name: irish stout
ingredients.notes: or substitute with another dark beer

instructions: Heat the irish stout in a large pot over medium heat until simmering.
Add the brine-dried turkey neck and cook for 5 minutes, or until browned.
Add the onion, carrot, celery, and garlic to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the flour and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the turkey neck is tender.
Season the stew with sodium-free seasoning blend and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Reheat the stew as needed before serving.
